# TerrainSpeed

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** TerrainSpeed

## What it does

TerrainSpeed bundles movement improvements for three specific surfaces — ladders/vines, ice, and water — into a single module. Each sub-system can be toggled independently, so you can enable only the surfaces that are relevant to your situation without affecting the others.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/terrainspeed). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
